fields.aka: Candraśekhara Ācārya, Ācāryaratna, Ācāryaśekhara, Candraśekhara Deva, Śrīla Chandraśekhara Acaryaratna, Ācārya Ratna
fields.notes:
Uncle of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu: husband of Śacī Devī's sister (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.13). Performed the rites of the Lord's sannyāsa at Keśava Bhāratī's āśrama in Kāṭoyā.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Śaṅkhanidhi, one of the nine nidhis (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 102); the presence of Candra (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 112).

«Ācāryaratna» is his title: the Caitanya-caritāmṛta (Ādi 13.102, 108) shows that Ācāryaratna and Candraśekhara are the same person; the Vaiṣṇava-vandanās of Jīva Gosvāmī, Devakīnandana and Vṛndāvana dāsa name the title and the name in different verses. The record «Ācārya Ratna» #8 was joined to this one (07-11-2026, Whisper).

A disciple of Gadādhara-lineage, he belonegd to Sripata Vangavati. He was Kali in his past  incarnation. (GGD. 196, 206, CC. 1.12.85, Sakhanirnayamrta 27)

«Raṅgavāsī Vallabha» (Kali in his past incarnation, Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 196, 206) is this name copied wrongly: Haridāsa dāsa holds that «Vaṅgavāṭī Caitanyadāsa» became «Raṅgavāsī Vallabha» by a copyist's error (র / ব). The record «Rangavasi Vallabha» #1296 was joined to this one (07-11-2026, Whisper).
His name before was Gokulānanda Sena; «Vaiṣṇava dāsa» is the name he signed his works with. The record «Gokulananda Sena» #341 was joined to this one (07-11-2026, Whisper).
